no-restricted-globals.name: document
no-restricted-globals.message: No DOM on a device. React Native aliases window and self to global and never defines document, so this compiles, ships, and throws at runtime.

no-restricted-globals.name: matchMedia
no-restricted-globals.message: No DOM on a device. Use Appearance / useWindowDimensions.

no-restricted-globals.name: IntersectionObserver
no-restricted-globals.message: No DOM on a device. Use onLayout or a scroll handler.

no-restricted-globals.name: localStorage
no-restricted-globals.message: No DOM on a device. Use AsyncStorage.

no-restricted-globals.name: Node
no-restricted-globals.message: No DOM on a device. `Node.ELEMENT_NODE` was one of the four boot crashes of the Expo port.
